row.evidence: SeekOut's pricing table lists only an SSO / SAML row (from SeekOut Sourcing up), its help centre says supported IdPs are "Identity providers that support SAML 2.0", and Microsoft's Entra tutorial says "SeekOut supports Just In Time user provisioning"; no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: No SCIM; JIT-only on SAML sign-in (Entra tutorial), which the merge may reclassify. Sourcing Core is self-serve at $149/mo paid annually ($179 monthly) with 3 seats included (flat, so no per-user figure); SAML SSO starts on SeekOut Sourcing (Custom, billed annually, per-seat). SSO is configured by SeekOut staff from the customer's SAML metadata; new SSO users start as 'trial' users until an admin assigns a licence. Admins create, deactivate and delete accounts in Team Administration. The Partner API (by request) has no user endpoints.

plans.name: SeekOut Sourcing Core (Recruit Core)
plans.price_text: $149/mo (paid annually, upfront) $1,788/yr; $179/mo billed monthly; 3 seats included
plans.notes: Flat price for the plan; 14-day free trial.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented. Users are created by admins in Team Administration or just-in-time on SAML sign-in; SSO is set up by SeekOut staff from the customer's SAML metadata.

limitations.text: The Partner API (by request through a SeekOut representative) covers search, contact data, profile refresh and usage analytics; its OpenAPI spec has no user, team or licence endpoints.

entra.notes: Entra gallery app is SAML SSO with JIT user creation; no provisioning tutorial.
